subject: maths
question: Vineetha invests ₹12,000 on simple interest at the rate of 9% p.a. to obtain a total amount of ₹18,480 after a certain period. For how many years did she invest to obtain the above amount?
solution: Given: Sum = Rs. 12000 Rate = 9% Concept used: S.I = (P × T × R)/100 Amount = S.I + P
